Go for the traditional crispy Banh mi
Mar 2026 • Couples
I came here because I wanted to eat Banh mi but was worried about hygiene. I went there because it is within walking distance of the hotel in Meek K Beach.
It is said to have inherited the old taste, and although it was simple, the crispy bread and the pork inside were good.
The special drink, purple, which was served free of charge, was the natural color of butterfly peas and I was happy to serve it when I arrived in the hot weather.
Many of the staff were deaf and ordered on paper, but if they didn't understand, they responded. So, although there were some misplaced orders, I was impressed by how warm and hard they worked. I wanted such a lovely shop to last for a long time.
Please go.
